decisions.reason: Specific healthcare data breach affecting multiple North Carolina skilled nursing facilities operated by Asheville Beaverdam NC Opco (Bear Mountain Health and Rehabilitation, Elevate Health & Rehabilitation). Vendor claims stolen data was deleted. Real breach with named entities.
Standard Google Chrome security advisory (AV26-844) for version prior to 151.0.7922.173. Routine vendor patch notice with no substantive exploitation detail. Not worth a dedicated story.
Update 2 to Oracle January 2026 quarterly CPU advisory, adds CVE-2026-21962. Belongs in the existing Oracle CPU story as an update event.
Arctic Wolf vendor marketing piece about 24x7 monitoring and detection. Promotional content citing their own survey. Not a security event.
Massachusetts appeals court ruling requiring 'cognizable damage' for data breach claims. Meaningful legal precedent affecting data breach litigation standards.
